title: Verification pickup code format
goal: uses required and pattern to check whether the text box is filled in and whether the content conforms to the format.
summary: The self-service pickup page requires two uppercase English letters and four digits. Add validation rules that the browser can recognize to the input box.
tasks: Make the pickup code input box required.
uses pattern to limit the format of the pickup code. It starts with exactly two capital letters, followed by exactly four digits.
Try leaving it blank, entering ab0427 and entering AB0427, respectively, click "Check" to observe the native verification prompt.

example.code:
<label for="seat-number">seat number (such as C12)</label>
<input id="seat-number" name="seat" required pattern="[A-Z][0-9]{2}">
example.note: pattern matches the entire value. Square brackets describe optional characters, and curly braces specify the number. required additionally rejects null values.

hint: The space value can still pass the format check when only pattern is written. Add required, and use {2} and {4} to limit the number of letters and numbers respectively.
